cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate (C1): Sodium Laureth Sulfate (2) defining ether-sulfate anionic, buffered by Cocamidopropyl Betaine (4); TEA-Dodecylbenzenesulfonate (18) is a strong anionic but post-fragrance, so not a reinforcing route (C4). Sodium Xylenesulfonate (3) is a hydrotrope, not a route.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: Late TEA-Dodecylbenzenesulfonate and only one buffer argue toward strong, but C4 excludes the late sulfonate.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: one meaningful silicone-plus-guar deposition system, Dimethiconol (10), Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride (11), Dimethicone (14). C2 not met: both silicones are post-fragrance (not early), no pearlizing/fatty route, Panthenol (19) only humectant.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: Two silicones plus a cationic guar is a deliberate 2-in-1 coacervate architecture that can give substantial slip (neighbor high).

weightPotential.rationale: Moderate: a persistent silicone system (Dimethiconol 10, Dimethicone 14) converges with a cationic guar (11), so residue is plausible; no lipid, film or protein reinforces it and a buffered SLES chassis gives ordinary reset.
weightPotential.counterSignal: Silicone level unknown; silicone+guar coacervate deposition could be stronger (neighbor high by the N-ALT heavier tie-break).
